From strategy decks to creator deals.

I completed my B.Tech in Information Technology and started out as a strategy consultant, building go-to-market strategies for clients in the Netherlands. That work taught me how to break a messy business problem into a plan.

Then I moved into marketing. I've been in influencer marketing for the past 1.5 years, working independently. I started writing on LinkedIn a year ago, and the account now has 26K+ followers and about 10 million reach. Several posts crossed 100K, 200K and 300K impressions.

Along the way I pitched creators on my own, found campaigns for them and managed their brand deals. I also help agencies source creators. Now I want to do it inside a team like Opraah.
